seed_uncertainty.unit: eight seed identities, shared multiplicities across the four fixed folds
seed_uncertainty.within_fold: renormalize over 8/8/7/7 available seed cells; redraw if a fold has zero available multiplicity
seed_uncertainty.interval: approximate percentile95 conditional on fixed exposed folds/data/ancestry

evaluation_uncertainty: separate component-cluster paired bootstrap with fits fixed, same component multiplicities for all seeds and arms within a fold; does not measure fitting variation
multiple_comparisons: freeze primary comparison family and correction (e.g. Holm) before any fit; no portfolio-wide significance from uncorrected per-card intervals
ancestry: source-qualified component-clean fitting, teachers, initializers and normalizers per outer fold; selection stays inside fitting components
exposure: all four folds already exposed; no fresh holdout or chronological guarantee
pending_before_fit: implemented candidate/control adapters and executable commands
measured real-shape resource profile and approved budget
predeclared useful effect/cost threshold and primary comparison family
scope: A comparison design, not a launchable training recipe or allocation.
